title: Input-boundary probe run
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type, let $x$ be a word over $\Gamma$ with positive length, and let $d$ be a four-work-tape machine configuration on input $x$ whose state is the probe's start state. Then there exist a time $t\le 2$, a Boolean value $b$, and an input-head position $p$ such that after $t$ steps the probe is in state done with flag $b$ and input-head position $p$. Before time $t$ it is in no done state; moreover, $b$ is true exactly when the initial input-head position is the right boundary $|x|+1$, $p$ equals $|x|$ when $b$ is true and otherwise equals the initial input-head position, and all work-tape head positions remain unchanged through time $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a four-work-tape configuration on input $x$
$d$ is in the probe start state
